name: Fresh Creamed Corn Fettuccine with Lettuce, Cucumber & Tomato Salad

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Reserve 1 cup cooking water before draining; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 ears corn
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Remove husks and silks from the corn. Using a knife, carefully slice corn kernels off the cobs and place in a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; peel and small dice half the onions (reserving the rest for later use). Add both to the bowl with the corn.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
1 ½ medium red onions

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add corn, garlic, onion, broth, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until corn starts to soften and break down, 10-12 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
355 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, and spices in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp white wine vinegar
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice remaining onion. Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise; slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl; set aside.
Cut cream cheese into small pieces. Finely grate Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ (227 g) block cream cheese
85 g Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: When the corn is ready, add cream cheese and Parmesan to the pot. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring often, until cheese melts and the sauce thickens slightly, 3-4 minutes.
Transfer pasta to the pot and toss to combine; add reserved pasta water, a few tablespoons at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency. Remove from heat.
Add mixed greens to the bowl with the veggies and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide pasta and salad between plates. Enjoy!
